title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins manage federated Copilot connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The briefing incorrectly says Microsoft documents only three admin controls, although Microsoft also documents tool-level blocking and the briefing itself later acknowledges that further control. The roadmap facts, licensing, and listed automation are supported; two navigation paths need small completions, and the write-action description should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation.
